lamps.steady: Malfunction with the SRS or pre-tensioner system. Have it inspected by an authorized dealer as soon as possible.
Indicates that shifting up or down to the shown gear is desired.
Informs the driver that the seat belt is not fastened.

lamps.lamp: Parking Brake & Brake Fluid Warning Light
lamps.steady: Parking brake is applied or brake fluid is low. If fluid is low, stop driving and check for leaks.
There is a malfunction with the ABS. Normal braking still works, but seek dealer inspection.

lamps.lamp: Electronic Brake force Distribution (EBD) System Warning Light
lamps.steady: ABS and regular brakes may not work normally. Avoid high speeds and seek dealer inspection immediately.
There is a malfunction with the EPS. Steering effort may change; see a dealer.
Malfunction with the emission control system. Drive to a dealer for inspection to avoid engine damage.
lamps.flashing: Diesel only: injection quantity adjustment error. May cause power loss or combustion noise.

lamps.steady: Malfunction with the alternator or charging system. Stop safely and check the drive belt.
Engine oil pressure is low. Stop the vehicle, turn off the engine, and check the oil level.
The fuel tank is nearly empty. Add fuel as soon as possible.
The washer fluid reservoir is nearly empty. Refill the washer fluid.
Malfunction with the LED headlamp. Seek dealer inspection.
lamps.flashing: Malfunction with a LED headlamp related part. Inspect via authorized Genesis retailer.

lamps.steady: Malfunction in low engine oil or tire pressure systems. Check the LCD display for details.
One or more tires are significantly underinflated. Check and inflate tires.
lamps.flashing: TPMS malfunction if it flashes for 60 seconds then stays on. See a dealer.

lamps.steady: Diesel only: water has accumulated in the fuel filter. Drain the water immediately.

lamps.lamp: Exhaust System (DPF or LNT) Warning Light
lamps.steady: Malfunction with DPF/LNT. Drive over 60 km/h or at specific RPM for 25 minutes to clear.
lamps.flashing: Diesel only: long-term blinking indicates DPF damage or degraded LNT performance.

lamps.steady: Diesel engine is preheating. Wait for the light to go out before starting.
lamps.flashing: Malfunction with the engine preheating system.

lamps.steady: A door is not closed securely.
The trunk is not closed securely.
Malfunction within the ESC system.
lamps.flashing: The ESC system is currently operating.

lamps.lamp: Electronic Stability Control (ESC) OFF Indicator Light
lamps.steady: The ESC system has been deactivated.
Valid key detected; engine can be started.
lamps.flashing: Key not in vehicle, battery low, or system malfunction.

lamps.steady: Steady light indicates a malfunction in the system.
lamps.flashing: Normal operation of the turn signal.

lamps.steady: The headlamps are turned on.
Headlights are in high beam position or being flashed.
The tail lights or headlights are on.
The front fog lights are on.
The cruise control system is enabled.
A cruise control speed has been set.
